<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

<!-- PR title: [Type] scope: title, or [Type] [Hardware] scope: title.
Type: Feat, Fix, Refactor, Perf, Doc, Test, CI, or Chore.
Scope: any module or model name (no fixed list or letter-case restriction), e.g. attention, qwen3, or flash-attn.
Hardware: optional single tag without spaces. Use uppercase hardware tags (AMD, NVIDIA, NPU, MI300X), except for exactly these four spellings: Intel, Apple, Huawei, Ascend.
Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

Bumps the AITER pin for the two gfx1250 build stages (`gfx1250-rocm1000` and
`gfx1250-rocm1010`) from `2bb549102` to `26f4f1fb2`. This is a **gfx1250-only**
change — the gfx942 / gfx950 / shared pins (`285579b6…`, 8 occurrences) are left
untouched.

## Modifications

```
docker/rocm.Dockerfile
  L347 (gfx1250-rocm1000)  AITER_COMMIT_DEFAULT  2bb549102… → 26f4f1fb2…
  L370 (gfx1250-rocm1010)  AITER_COMMIT_DEFAULT  2bb549102… → 26f4f1fb2…
```

## Accuracy Tests

Not run locally; this Docker dependency update requires AMD GPU image/accuracy CI. Docker is not available in the local environment.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not run as a gate.

- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

files.patch:
@@ -341,10 +341,10 @@ ENV BUILD_TRITON="1"
 ENV BUILD_LLVM="0"
 ENV BUILD_AITER_ALL="1"
 ENV BUILD_MOONCAKE="1"
-# gfx1250 now shares the gfx942/gfx950 AITER pin. The four MoE a8w4/a4w4 Gluon
-# reverts it used to carry were dropped: they no longer apply to this tree, and
-# measurement showed they cost ~0.007 GSM8K accuracy rather than protecting it.
-ENV AITER_COMMIT_DEFAULT="2bb549102ba2d9e51da8ef21107361827075d8b6"
+# gfx1250 is promoted to its own AITER pin here, ahead of the gfx942/gfx950
+# shared pin. Validated by the manual gfx1250 AITER Scout #173 A/B (no automated
+# gfx1250 Scout): gpt-oss, Flux.2, Wan2.2 and Kimi-K2 all NO_NEW_REGRESSION.
+ENV AITER_COMMIT_DEFAULT="26f4f1fb2de14d122c71f5fed7afb97a5c97cade"
 # The upstream Triton the gfx1250 bring-up was validated against, carried over
 # from the ROCm 7.14 flavor this image replaced. Built from source below.
 ENV TRITON_COMMIT_DEFAULT="76940ad348795521b3dc9f6c79acd7309ff924e3"
@@ -367,7 +367,7 @@ ENV TRITON_REVERT_COMMITS_DEFAULT="9debefe44117a44c274b05033cfe9e4858883b86"
 ENV BUILD_LLVM="0"
 ENV BUILD_AITER_ALL="1"
 ENV BUILD_MOONCAKE="1"
-ENV AITER_COMMIT_DEFAULT="2bb549102ba2d9e51da8ef21107361827075d8b6"
+ENV AITER_COMMIT_DEFAULT="26f4f1fb2de14d122c71f5fed7afb97a5c97cade"
 ENV BUILD_RCCL="1"
 # Head of ROCm/rocm-systems#14254: develop plus a fix for a hang in the first
 # all-reduce on gfx1250. Not merged yet; move to develop once it is.
